scope: Append-only evidence comparison; no source, routing, auth, IAM, payload or paid changes. Supersedes any implied preference for SSM.
recommendation: Prefer existing query-only HTTP composition for deployment data-plane traffic and an explicitly bounded S3 publication capability for later activation authority, subject to source review. This avoids host developer credentials, IAM and SSH. Current code does not yet implement operator authentication or remote activation delivery.

Existing scoped expiring request capabilities; raw URLs stay private

s3ActivationOption.prelaunchDelegation: Pin unique campaign, exact source/manifest/network/artifact identities, fixed bucket/key and narrow root-only expiring GET capability before launch. This authorizes only a fixed public deployment-evidence envelope for that campaign, never arbitrary commands, URLs, paths, environment, code or new resource requests. No host AWS credential or write capability.
s3ActivationOption.unknownFutureBinding: Actual deployment addresses, object bytes/hash and VersionId do not exist at launch. An unversioned scoped GET cannot honestly be described as prebound to a future exact version/hash. The trust boundary is the existing authorized object writer and TLS-authenticated S3 response, limited by precommitted campaign/network/artifact schema. If independent cryptographic signer authorization beyond that account is required, a small fixed signed commitment must be separately reviewed; do not silently assume one exists.
operatorPublication: After actual deployment/Ready/canonical verification, write an exclusive fsynced local intent for one unique activation key with full expected bytes/checksum; upload once using If-None-Match:* and expected owner
Reconcile uncertain write by exact key/version/checksum, never retry the financial or transaction action
HEAD/GET exact returned VersionId and checksum, record public envelope SHA and object VersionId; keep capability URLs out of the public envelope/evidence
Envelope contains only captured closed public deployment/scope/evidence fields. No private keys, RPC credentials, executable command or generic configuration loader
hostConsumptionProposal: Reuse existing root attestor timer ownership; no separate polling daemon or generic job runner. Explicitly opt into one finite activation window/counter under the original absolute shutdown deadline

Proposed bound for review: at most60 fixed-key reads, spaced at least30s, a maximum30-minute window, and no read/start when less than15minutes remains. Exact scheduling must bind the final campaign budget and node-ready/deployment timeline before implementation

Bound each response/time/bytes, no redirects/fallback; validate fixed host/key/S3 version metadata and strict envelope.404 means not yet published within the finite window, other failures remain explicit

On first valid object, exclusively persist observed VersionId plus full SHA/bytes before writing separate root-only scope/evidence files; any subsequent difference or existing activation intent is reconcile-only

Run existing activation validation unchanged against current manifest/artifacts, canonical FPC, class/address/deployer/constructor/config/Ready, fresh L1/L2 anchors and controls; hash-match scope file to consumed envelope
Preserve existing durable intent before unmask/start and terminal shutdown on failure. Never change deadlines, account scope or current proof assertions from envelope content
gates: Source claim needed for narrow authenticated commitment/consumption integration; not present in1797
Unknown publication outcome and existing intent never produce duplicate activation
No private authority copied into prover-readable config; strict root/prover traversal and egress separation
Exact projected activated receipt must distinguish delivery accepted from actual full prover readiness/proof pass
